What each kind is:

- `trial-batch`: One trials.py batch: per instance cast, samples, rows, the mind's journal (real model requests and replies), mind log, summary; the batch report.
- `trials-archive`: Trial batches packed by hand into tarballs after their checkout was cleaned.
- `trial-ledger`: trials.py's ledger of real tokens per batch, and other small batch-side files.
- `journal-copy`: Live mind journals of trial databases; trials.py copies each into its batch (instance/journal) when the instance stops.
- `mind-journal`: Mind journals of verify/lab/play databases that are not part of a trial batch.
- `verify-evidence`: Verification evidence (.local/living/verify/<run>): logs, SQL dumps, journals of verify-* scratch databases.
- `play-session`: An owner play session: journals, client/mind logs, authority rows, the report page, stills and video, the owner's feedback.
- `motion-raw`: Raw Kimodo SOMA-77 takes (.npz) of the motion library on the Spark (~/kimodo-test/library, read-only).
- `motion-library-copy`: .local/kimodo/outputs/library: every take kept for the library, the input of gen_anim.sh/gen_person.sh.
- `cliplab`: Clip lab runs: takes per clip, checks.json scores, contact sheets.
- `clip-handoff`: Clip handoff tarballs (cliplab.py --handoff) with sha256.
- `clip-deliverable`: Hand-made tarballs and review folders of Kimodo clips sent between machines.
- `trial-build`: Trial modules (wasm), derived seeds and build logs.
- `build-output`: Cargo target folders inside .local/living (target-*, verify/build-*).
- `secret`: Files holding passwords or keys (neo4j.env, .env).
- `other`: Anything else under .local/living (logs of checks and runs).
- `never-touch`: A folder this machine must not touch; not scanned.
